answer: Persistent Thread Ledger: each identity must maintain a continuous on-chain thread of answered micro-challenges, one per random interval, and skipping more than a short tide of misses voids it. Every reply requires fresh inference work, so an attacker's per-identity cost is sustained compute and monitoring across all puppets, not a one-time fee. A whisper of inactivity from any thread triggers revalidation, making mass fake identities expensive to keep alive.
